semantics: Return sum(fabs(x[i*incx])) for 0 <= i < n, without modifying x. n==0 returns 0.0 without memory access and x may be NULL.
memory_contract: Vector increments are signed and nonzero. For negative increments, the caller passes the address of logical element zero. Inputs and outputs occupy disjoint storage except for DSCAL's in-place operand. Leading dimensions are in elements and at least the stored row width.
numeric_contract: Binary64 finite data unless a coefficient disables access and the harness provides inaccessible inputs or poison. Reassociation and FMA are allowed within |observed-reference| <= 2e-12 + 3e-12*|reference|. Only logical output elements may be written; input bytes, output padding and guards must remain unchanged.
